sn41.1:1.1: Macchikāsaṇḍa was a township in Kāsī ([pli-tv-kd11:18.1.3]()), known only through its connection with Citta. The name probably means “Fisher’s Forest”.
sn41.1:2.1: Migapathaka (“place of the animal track”) is only mentioned here.
sn41.1:2.2: The use of _kira_ here shows that he did not hear them directly, but heard a report. Hence below he says “I heard that …” (_sutaṁ metaṁ_), cf. note on [mn127:17.4]().
